Anushka Sharma and her family have acquired three apartments in Mumbai for a combined Rs 44.1 crore, according to reports from leading Indian publications.

The properties are situated on the 24th floor of Godrej Skyshore in the city’s Versova neighbourhood. The parents’ portion of the deal consists of two flats valued at Rs 25.8 crore, while the remaining unit completes the trio.

Coverage of the transaction appeared across multiple outlets, including The Economic Times, The Times of India, The Indian Express, Bollywood Hungama and Moneycontrol, highlighting the deal’s prominence in the luxury real‑estate market.
